The real part of the sum of the coefficients of g(x) is −26. The sum of the coefficients is g(1).

**Roots of g.** Since z is a primitive cube root of unity, s₂ = z·s₁ and s₃ = z²·s₁. So the roots of g are s₁, zs₁, z²s₁, which gives g(x) = x³ − s₁³. Therefore g(1) = 1 − s₁³.

**Computing s₁³.** Let e₁ = 3, e₂ = −4, e₃ = −4 be the elementary symmetric sums of the roots of f. Expanding s₁³ = (r₁ + r₂z + r₃z²)³ and using z³ = 1 gives

s₁³ = Σrᵢ³ + 6r₁r₂r₃ + 3(Pz + Qz²),

where P = r₁²r₂ + r₂²r₃ + r₃²r₁ and Q = r₁²r₃ + r₂²r₁ + r₃²r₂.

- Σrᵢ³ = e₁³ − 3e₁e₂ + 3e₃ = 27 + 36 − 12 = 51.
- 6r₁r₂r₃ = 6e₃ = −24.
- P + Q = e₁e₂ − 3e₃ = −12 + 12 = 0, so Q = −P and Pz + Qz² = P(z − z²) = P·i√3, which is purely imaginary.

So Re(s₁³) = 51 − 24 = 27.

**Check.** The discriminant of f is 1264, so P² = 1264/4 = 316. Then |s₁³|² = 27² + 27·316 = 729 + 8532 = 9261 = 21³. This matches |s₁|⁶, since s₁·s̄₁ = Σrᵢ² − Σrᵢrⱼ = 17 + 4 = 21.

**Result.** Re(g(1)) = 1 − 27 = −26.

ANSWER: -26
